component.name: BedrockOnLinux
component.summary: Install and play Minecraft Bedrock on Linux

description.p: BedrockOnLinux installs and runs the Windows (GDK) edition of Minecraft Bedrock on Linux. You sign in with your Microsoft account, pick a version, and press Play: the launcher downloads the game from Microsoft with your account, prepares its own Wine engine, and starts it. Multiplayer servers, Realms, friends and the Marketplace work from inside the game. You must own Minecraft; no game files are included.

On first launch the launcher downloads its WineGDK engine and Microsoft Store downloader from the project's own releases, and umu-launcher, each checked against a SHA-256 pinned in the launcher. umu-launcher then fetches Valve's Steam Linux Runtime, the container the game runs in; that runtime follows Valve's releases and is not pinned by the launcher.

This is a community package. It installs the official AppImage from the project's GitHub releases, unmodified. Updates come through Flatpak; the launcher's own update check says so instead of replacing itself.
